newsitem.title: USA: Novacare Inc names two top executives.
newsitem.headline: Novacare Inc names two top executives.

text.p: NovaCare Inc said it promoted Timothy Foster to chief executive officer and named James McLane of Aetna Health Plans president, chief operating officer and a member of the board of directors.
The company said Foster, a founder of NovaCare, was previously the president and chief operating officer.
A company spokesman said the chief executive officer position was formerly part of the chairman's job, which is held by John Foster. John Foster is still the company's chairman.
McLane was previously chief executive officer of Aetna Health Plans and executive vice president of Aetna Life and Casualty in Hartford, Conn.
NovaCare provides physical rehabilitation and employee services.
